one_liner: PitchBook has a REST API (PB-Token API key) but access is a separate contract-gated Direct Data offering via account manager; sandbox key only after engaging sales. The vendor also offers an MCP (Premium Connector / Data MCP) for licensed customers.
auth_notes: Static key sent as 'Authorization: PB-Token {API_KEY}'. Purchased API credits are also required per call. The MCP Premium Connector authenticates via SSO for licensed users.
access_notes: API is a separate offering requiring a standalone contract; the key is provided by PitchBook, the sandbox key is requested from the account manager, and credits are invoiced via the Customer Success Manager. No self-serve signup or trial.
blocker_notes: Credentials only via a sales/contract conversation with PitchBook's Direct Data team or account manager, plus purchased API credits. Docs are public on Postman but keys are not self-serve.

evidence.quote: include a header named "Authorization" with the value of "PB-Token {API_KEY}" with each API request.
The API is a separate offering from the PitchBook platform that requires a standalone contract agreement.
Please reach out to your account manager to request a sandbox key.
To start your API connection, you will need to send a request directly to our Direct Data team
The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser.
AI partners connect securely to PitchBook’s Premium Connector (built on MCP server technology) directly through the partner’s site.
The PitchBook Data MCP is currently live and available to customers upon request.
